rows.observation: 原文以“While Furnace is on”限定护甲高温及减伤效果，译文遗漏了熔炉开启时这一条件。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/furnace.lua Molten Metal（本库“融化金属”）：callbackOnTakeDamage 首行 if not self:isTalentActive(self.T_FURNACE) then return end，减伤只在熔炉（Furnace，本库“熔炉”）开启时生效；现译删去 While Furnace is on，把条件效果写成常驻（删限定词缺陷），句首补“熔炉开启时，”。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文 herbs 为草药，译文“一束植物”丢失了草药这一具体含义。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/ingredients.lua：stack of herbs (…) 五种原料本库一致作“一束植物（…）”（tome-orcs.lua:1835-1839、1856-1859），描述 A stack of herbs 作“一束草药”；改为“草药”需五条同步，属跨批次统一，记 advisory。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文攻击范围为 7，译文写成 6 码。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua:1034-1099 OVERCLOCK（本库“炮台超载”）：callbackOnActBase 以 core.fov.circle_grids(self.x, self.y, 6, true) 取目标、tg range=6，实际射程为 6；源文 range 7 与实现不符，现译“6 码范围”贴合实现，保留。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文称解放了 Prides，译文改为解放了“兽人”；冻结输入没有提供两者等同的依据。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/overload/data/texts/unlock-orcs_campaign_rogue.lua：同第312批 074da418（法师版），The Prides 即被关押的兽人各部落，本库同事件成就作“释放拘留营中的部落成员”（tome-orcs.lua:51）；现译“拘留营的兽人”指代不误，未用“部落”，记 advisory。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: source 的 subdued orcs 指被制服或压服的兽人，target 写成被关押的兽人，改变了处境。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/quests/free-prides.lua:26、32：任务说明写明兽人“are subdued into obedience by a powerful psionic, Mindwall”，subdued orcs 是被灵能压服的兽人；split his mind 是分裂心智（意念之墙为灵能者），现译“灵魂”偏离，另增“找到了一种办法”、把 subdued 写成“被关押”；整句改为“你摧毁了意念之墙的身躯，但他设法把自己的心智分裂成许多块，直接控制了那些被他压服的兽人。”与 contextual 同条观察合并确认。 本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: source 的 Even if this great tree’s growth IS a sign 保留假设，target 写成这棵巨树的形成本身就是，将假设说成既定事实。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/lore/primal-forest.lua 修复者警告：Even if this great tree's growth IS a sign of the planet successfully fighting the infection off 是让步假设（即便巨树生长确是星球击退感染的迹象，化身仍可爬下再感染），且与上文“最好/最坏情况”两种推测呼应；现译“尽管这棵巨树的形成本身就是……举措”把假设写成定论，growth 也译成“形成”；改为“即使这棵巨树的生长真的是这颗星球成功把感染推出体外的迹象”。 本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: source electricity 是电或电能，target 电子学对应 electronics，词义明显不符。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/tinkers.lua:26：electricity 是配方大类 base_category（与 smith/mechanical/therapeutics/chemistry/explosives 并列，本库作铁匠/机械/治疗学/化学/爆炸学），electricity 是电学/电力而非 electronics；现译“电子学”误译，改为“电学”。全库仅此一处。 本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文规定同一目标每回合最多受到一次该效果伤害；译文写成每回合最多只能伤害一个目标，改变了可伤害的目标数量。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/magnetism.lua:21-61 Static Shock（本库“静电震击”）说明：cannot damage the same target more than once per turn 是对同一目标每回合最多一次，可电击多个目标；现译“每回合最多只能对一个目标伤害一次”改成只打一个目标；will not interact with Counterstrike 是不与反击交互，现译“不会消耗反击效果”偏窄；整句改为“这一效果每回合对同一目标最多造成一次伤害，且不会与反击效果相互作用。” 本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: The translation drops the condition 'While Furnace is on' (source furnace.lua:92). '你的护甲温度极高，能驱散部分能量攻击' reads as always active, but the damage reduction only applies while Furnace is on. Suggest adding a lead-in such as '熔炉开启时'.
rows.conclusion: 同 surface 裁决：furnace.lua callbackOnTakeDamage 仅在 T_FURNACE 激活时生效，现译删去 While Furnace is on。 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: Numeric error: the source says 'within range 7' (tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua:1036, a hardcoded literal), but the translation says '6 码范围内'. It should say 7.
rows.conclusion: 宿主补查 envelope 外实现：physical.lua:1080-1090 OVERCLOCK callbackOnActBase 用 core.fov.circle_grids(…, 6, …) 且 tg range=6，实际射程为 6；源文 range 7 与实现不符，现译“6”贴合实现，保留。 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: Meaning drift (free-prides.lua:32). 'split his mind' is translated as '灵魂', but Mindwall is a psionic enemy and the same quest mentions 'Mindwall's psionic powers', so it should be '心智／意识'. 'subdued orcs' means mentally subjugated orcs, but '被关押' changes it to physically imprisoned. The translation also adds '找到了一种办法', which is not in the source.
rows.conclusion: 同 surface 裁决：free-prides.lua:26 subdued into obedience by a powerful psionic，mind 应为心智，删“找到了一种办法”，subdued 为“被压服”。 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: The concessive hypothetical becomes a statement of fact (primal-forest.lua:38). The source 'Even if this great tree's growth IS a sign of the planet successfully fighting the infection off' is a hypothetical, consistent with the best/worst case uncertainty in the earlier paragraph. The translation '尽管这棵巨树的形成本身就是…的举措' asserts it as fact and drops 'successfully'. Suggest '即使这棵巨树的生长确实说明这颗星球正在成功地把感染推出去'.
rows.conclusion: 同 surface 裁决：primal-forest.lua Even if … IS a sign 为让步假设，现译写成定论且漏 successfully。 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: Mechanic mistranslated (magnetism.lua:61). 'This effect cannot damage the same target more than once per turn' limits damage to once per turn for each individual target. The translation '每回合最多只能对一个目标伤害一次' reads as hitting at most one target per turn in total. It should be '同一目标每回合最多受到一次伤害'. Also, 'will not interact with Counterstrike' means it does not trigger or interact with Counterstrike, but '不会消耗反击效果' narrows this to 'consume' without evidence.
rows.conclusion: 同 surface 裁决：magnetism.lua 同一目标每回合最多一次，非只打一个目标；Counterstrike 为不交互而非不消耗。 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

notes: All-Orcs batch: surface ran as four lanes of 20. Every lane echoed its identities exactly and the boundary scan passed without a manual audit.
The contextual run read only its own envelope, the contract and the Orcs source; no refreeze was needed.

Implementation-backed: Molten Metal only reduces damage while Furnace is active; Overclock's bolt actually uses range 6, so the translation's 6 follows the code and the source text's 7 is an upstream mismatch.
Mindwall's quest text says the orcs are subdued into obedience by psionics, so 'subdued orcs' are mind-controlled, not merely imprisoned.
Orcs public source file SHA matched this batch workset; source repository and commit remain unpinned.
5 confirmed repair revisions raise the window 37 backlog from 13 to 18; below the 20 threshold, so no window opens.
